title: Python fundamentals
summary: Learn syntax, data structures, functions, testing, and practical automation for backend and data work.

title: SQL and relational data
summary: Practice filtering, joins, aggregation, transactions, indexes, and query design against relational databases.

title: Machine learning foundations
summary: Build fluency in supervised learning, evaluation, feature engineering, model selection, and responsible validation.

title: Deep learning foundations
summary: Study neural networks, optimization, regularization, representation learning, and practical training workflows.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
summary: Learn document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval, grounding, and evaluation for knowledge assistants.

title: Text embeddings
summary: Understand vector representations, similarity search, normalization, and embedding model tradeoffs for semantic retrieval.

title: Vector search systems
summary: Learn nearest-neighbor indexing, cosine similarity, metadata filtering, and relevance evaluation for semantic search.

title: Large language models
summary: Explore tokenization, prompting, context windows, evaluation, and practical limitations of language model applications.

title: Natural language processing
summary: Cover text preprocessing, classification, information extraction, language representations, and NLP evaluation.

title: Production APIs with FastAPI
summary: Build typed Python APIs with validation, dependency injection, asynchronous handlers, documentation, and testing.

title: Container fundamentals
summary: Learn images, containers, Dockerfiles, networking, volumes, Compose, and repeatable application deployment.

title: Kubernetes fundamentals
summary: Understand pods, deployments, services, configuration, scaling, and operational patterns for container orchestration.

title: AWS cloud foundations
summary: Build cloud fundamentals across identity, compute, storage, networking, monitoring, and cost-aware architecture.

title: React user interfaces
summary: Practice components, state, events, effects, data fetching, accessibility, and maintainable frontend composition.

title: Modern JavaScript
summary: Learn language fundamentals, modules, asynchronous programming, browser APIs, and testing for web applications.

title: Version control with Git
summary: Practice commits, branches, merges, rebases, history inspection, and collaborative change review.

title: PostgreSQL database skills
summary: Learn schema design, SQL querying, constraints, indexes, transactions, and operational database basics.

title: Data analysis with pandas
summary: Work with tabular data using selection, joins, grouping, missing values, reshaping, and reproducible analysis.

title: Deep learning with PyTorch
summary: Build tensor workflows, datasets, neural network modules, training loops, and model evaluation pipelines.

title: LangChain application patterns
summary: Use prompts, retrievers, document loaders, tools, and composable chains to build language model applications.
